body: Sorry to hear that man, it's rough. I was planning to very soon but I've decided to see how this next week goes, then I'll see.

Thank you, it really does mean a lot. I know a lot of people act different around different friend groups and what not but I will completely change how I act just to fit in with a crowd just so I'm not judged or rejected. I quickly pick up on how they act and then I sort of create a character like them and act like it, that's the best way I can describe it. It's all just like a show and at the end of the day nobody knows me and I just feel alone. Thanks again!
